title: Lesson 17: Large Data Volumes: Archiving, Big Objects, Skinny Tables, and Indexing Strategy
description: How an org stays fast and inside its storage as volume grows: selectivity and custom indexes, skinny tables for read-heavy hot data, big objects for bulk historical storage, and archiving as the tier that sheds cold data before it drags everything down.
